about: Vantage's director script: the 22 presses of its fifteen beats, as data the demo kit's director runs (public/demo-kit/director.js). Not a published beat document: those are beats/*.json, which scripts/seed-vantage.mjs re-anchors and rewrites and the worker applies by name. Strings are templates over the facts vantage.js computes (facts()); run lists are the kit's verbs; call is the one escape hatch into vantage.js.

beats.label: A stranger arrives from the ad
declare: Taps a paid-social ad and lands on the homepage ({{arrival.entry}})

{{#region.override}}Rehearsal override: region = {{region.override}} from the address bar (?region=), asserted and labelled{{/region.override}}{{^region.override}}Her region comes from the request: the edge locates her, and nothing is asserted{{/region.override}}
will: The hero and the four answer the ad and her region: the campaign lifts its promotion, her region’s own sales lean the rest

The Arrival panel names {{#region.override}}the override’s region, labelled as asserted{{/region.override}}{{^region.override}}the region the edge located, from the request{{/region.override}}, the grain, the census figure and the regional lean, each labelled
Her own meters are empty: nothing about her is known yet
beats.line: A stranger taps a paid-social ad. The first paint answers the ad and where she is: {{#region.override}}her region is a rehearsal override, labelled{{/region.override}}{{^region.override}}her region comes from the request{{/region.override}}, the campaign lifts its promotion and the carrier’s own regional sales lean the rest. Aggregate, never the individual; we curate, never price.

beats.label: The same visitor, another region
declare: Asserts region = {{region.contrast}}{{#region.contrastName}} ({{region.contrastName}}){{/region.contrastName}} on the request: asserted, not observed; nothing about her changes
will: A different opening four: only the region changed
The Arrival panel shows the asserted region’s grain, census figure and lean, labelled asserted, not observed
Her meters do not move: a region is context, never evidence about her
beats.line: Same visitor, same ad. Only the region changes, to {{region.contrastName || region.contrast}}, asserted, not observed, and the page opens differently: the prior is that region’s own sales. The census figure explains the lean and is never scored.

note: asserted, not observed · context on the request · never evidence about her

beats.label: She browses Samsung

declare.text: Back in {{region.ownName}}, her own region ({{#region.override}}the rehearsal override, labelled{{/region.override}}{{^region.override}}from the request, nothing asserted{{/region.override}})

will: brand samsung crosses the entry threshold on three touches; ecosystem and price band accumulate over the regional prior
The homepage is not asked while she browses, so the four do not move yet
beats.line: Back in her own region, she browses Samsung: the Galaxy S26 card, its page, then the S26 Ultra. Each is a real event, and brand samsung crosses the entry threshold on her own meters. The four are not asked again until she goes home.

beats.label: The hinge: the {{hinge.name || 'Pixel'}}, then home
will: Her Android interest now spans two makers; brand samsung is past the entry threshold
Android promotions overtake the lifted launch promotion; the receipts say what carried each one
beats.line: The hinge. The ad said iPhone; she has been looking at Android. She opens a Pixel and comes back, and the four follow her. Why these shows what carried each one.

after.line: The hinge. The ad said iPhone; she has been looking at Android. The four follow her, and the receipt says why: campaign context superseded by observed behaviour.

beats.label: She stops touching it
declare: Nothing. Nobody touches the page for a minute; then the page asks again
will: Brand memory is {{exit.room}} in this room: brand samsung decays below the {{exit.thetaOut}} exit threshold on the meter
The Galaxy receipts lose their Samsung driver; the Phones for you rail re-sorts on the same answer
The four can keep their order: ranking is continuous, and ecosystem android still carries them
beats.line: Everyone shows joining an audience. Watch her leave one. Nobody touches the page for a minute; the page asks again, and the engine’s answer withdraws the Samsung claim while her Android lean holds.

timer.head: Nobody touches the page
timer.text: The page asks again after a minute; the engine’s answer, not the page’s.
timer.status: the page asks again in {{left}} s

beats.label: She opens the {{focus.name}}
will: Six modules below the buy box, in the order her browsing already earns; Why these explains each one
Compare → Fresh visitor shows the template order beside hers
One decision on every surface: the trade-in module explains the offer the homepage led with; the buy box is marked off limits
beats.line: The phone page. The buy box is off limits: never decided, never personalised. Below it, six modules in the order her browsing already earns, and the trade-in module carries the same offer the homepage chose, explained, not decided again.

beats.label: She steps storage and compares the camera
will: Price band and contentType compare rise; a storage step that crosses $900 moves the band
Storage & memory rises, leading with {{storageStep.label}} at its real monthly delta
beats.line: She steps to {{storageStep.label}} and compares the camera. The monthly figure rises by the real delta, +{{storageStep.delta}}, and the page states the maths. Storage & memory rises.

beats.label: She opens the hotspot & travel starter
declare: Opens the hotspot & travel starter on {{plans.more}}, in Pair with a plan
will: perk hotspot-travel and category plans move
Pair with a plan rises; {{plans.more}} leads on the hotspot & travel starter
Capture it, then Compare with the streaming shopper: {{plans.max}} leads with the streaming bundle
beats.line: She opens the hotspot & travel starter. Pair with a plan rises and {{plans.more}} leads. Capture it, and the Compare tool shows the streaming shopper beside her.

else.missing: no plan card on this page offers the hotspot & travel starter

beats.label: Four lines, then the kids’ watch
declare: Sets the line selector to four lines
will: lines family moves on the selector, then with intent add-line and category watches-tablets on the watch page
Watch, tablet and more lines rises with the four-line per-line price; a household total appears
The family starter ({{plans.go}}) leads in Pair with a plan
beats.line: She sets the lines to four and looks at a kids’ watch. The connected-devices module rises with the four-line price, a household total appears, and the family starter leads.

beats.label: Home: the family hero and the four-line offer
will: The family hero leads the page
The four-line promotion enters the four: what she did on the phone page reaches the homepage
beats.line: Back on the homepage the hero and the four follow what she did on the phone page: the family hero, and the four-line promotion enters. One profile, every surface.

beats.label: She will bring her own phone
declare: {{#focus.canBack}}Goes back to the {{focus.name}} page (the browser’s Back){{/focus.canBack}}{{^focus.canBack}}Opens the {{focus.name}} again{{/focus.canBack}}
Answers “bring your own” in the buy box
will: ctx.intent = byod is asserted on every decision, labelled, as her account would
Offers that need another answer fail closed
Simple leads Pair with a plan for the switcher; the public prices do not change
beats.line: She says she will bring her own phone. The answer is asserted on the request, as her account would, and it routes the propositions: Simple leads for the switcher. Same public prices.

beats.label: Home: the switcher’s homepage
will: The switch hero leads
Bring your phone enters the four on her declared answer; the offers that need a new line fail closed, and the ungated pre-order can still rank above it
beats.line: On the homepage her answer routes the offers too: the switch hero, and bring your own phone enters the four. The offers that need a new line fail closed.

beats.label: Then she is upgrading
declare: {{#focus.canBack}}Goes back to the {{focus.name}} page (the browser’s Back){{/focus.canBack}}{{^focus.canBack}}Opens the {{focus.name}} again{{/focus.canBack}}
will: Her answer flips from “bring your own” to upgrade: ctx.intent = upgrade is asserted on every decision, labelled
{{plans.more}} leads Pair with a plan for the trade-in shopper
Her plan choice is kept for the continue hero: her selections, nothing inferred
Watch protection; it rises when the premium band is strong
beats.line: She is upgrading instead: her answer flips from bring-your-own to upgrade, asserted on the request. {{plans.more}} leads Pair with a plan for the trade-in shopper. She picks the plan that leads; it is her selection, and the page keeps it. Watch protection; it rises when the premium band is strong.

beats.label: Home: the upgrade offer leads
will: The new-line offers leave: their rule needs a new line
The upgrade offer leads, with its terms: what it requires and what ends the credit
beats.line: On the homepage the new-line offers are gone, because their rule needs a new line, and the upgrade offer leads with its terms: what it requires, and what ends the credit.

after.line: On the homepage the new-line offers are gone, because their rule needs a new line, and the upgrade offer leads: {{deals.leadTitle}}, with its terms: what it requires, and what ends the credit.

beats.label: Merchandiser: two weeks pass

declare.text: Asserts her answer back to “{{intent.defaultWord}}” for the merchandiser’s day

declare: The CMS clock moves two weeks on
will: A launch promotion’s window closes: it leaves its container and stops being a candidate
Its successor takes the container; nothing was switched off and no test ended
beats.line: Two weeks pass. A launch promotion’s window closes and the next promotion takes the container. No test ended, no winner was declared, nobody configured anything.

note: the merchandiser’s day, seen as a new line

beats.label: Merchandiser: Black Friday arrives
declare: Publishes the Black Friday switcher offer, live from this minute
will: A promotion nobody has ever clicked reaches the module on its metadata alone
It reaches the shopper whose behaviour says switch
beats.line: Black Friday: the switcher offer, no trade-in, live this minute. Nobody has clicked it, so it is placed on its metadata alone.

beats.label: Merchandiser: pin the iPhone Duo pre-order
declare: Pins the iPhone Duo pre-order (16 October) for everyone
will: The pre-order takes container one for everyone (a pin is a required prefix); its receipt reads ranking skipped
The other three are still ranked for her
beats.line: Launch week for the foldable: the iPhone Duo pre-order is pinned to container one for everyone. Ranking never ran for it; the other three are still hers.

run.name: {{beatNames.pinDuo}}
note: container one for everyone · ranking skipped

beats.label: 5G Home where it is available
declare: {{#home.own}}In {{home.name}}, her own region, where 5G Home is available: {{#region.override}}the rehearsal override (?region=), as before{{/region.override}}{{^region.override}}from the request, nothing asserted{{/region.override}}{{/home.own}}{{^home.own}}Asserts region = {{home.key}}{{#home.keyName}} ({{home.keyName}}){{/home.keyName}}, where 5G Home is available: asserted, not observed, because {{home.notWhy}}{{/home.own}}

declare.text: {{#focus.canBack}}Goes back to the {{focus.name}} page (the browser’s Back){{/focus.canBack}}{{^focus.canBack}}Opens the {{focus.name}}{{/focus.canBack}}

will: intent home and category home-internet move: the address check is a start order, the heaviest touch here
Add home internet carries a rule (only where 5G Home is available): eligible here, it rises on her address check
beats.line: {{#home.own}}In {{home.name}}, her own region,{{/home.own}}{{^home.own}}{{home.notWhyCap}}, so the page asserts {{home.name}}, where it is, labelled asserted, not observed; there{{/home.own}} she checks an address for 5G Home. The home-internet module carries a rule, only where 5G Home is available: here it is eligible, and her address check moves it up the page. A condition the request does not carry fails closed.

note: asserted, not observed · 5G Home is available there · {{home.notWhy}}

beats.label: The same shopper where it is not
will: Add home internet leaves the six: still published, still in its window, simply not eligible here
beats.line: The same shopper in {{regions.uncoveredName || regions.uncovered}}. Nothing about her changed; the module is gone because its rule does not hold here. A rule on the piece, not a preference.

note: asserted, not observed · not covered by 5G Home

beats.label: She adds it to her cart and comes back
will: Her first cart add makes her deciding, so the continue hero is in stage
The hero is now her own priced configuration with one next step: her selections, nothing inferred
beats.line: She adds the phone to her cart and comes back. The hero is now her priced configuration, with one next step. Their homepage stayed static after the same journey.

beats.label: Tomorrow’s template puts deals first
declare: Tomorrow’s homepage template moves the deals module to position one
will: The module renders first
The same four, in the same order: a slot is addressed by name, not position
beats.line: Tomorrow’s template moves the deals module to position one, and the four do not change. {{slots.deals}} is {{slots.deals}} wherever their template puts it, and its evidence follows the name.

run.label: tomorrow’s
note: their CMS moves the deals module to position one

beats.label: The clicks, and the day report
declare: Clicks two of the four, as a shopper would
will: Each click is credited to the promotion that held the container
The report: attribution per promotion and per module, not incrementality
beats.line: Two clicks, each credited to what held the container. Learned shows attribution per promotion and per module: module engagement, attach, plan mix. Never a lift number; lift is theirs to read against a holdout.
